title: FlashAttention from Scratch
blurb: Build exact attention that never materialises the score matrix: safe softmax, online softmax, merging partial results, tiling, causal skipping and memory-traffic counts.
intro: FlashAttention computes exact attention tile by tile so the quadratic score matrix never leaves on-chip memory. The steps build the pieces it rests on: a softmax that survives fully masked rows, the online softmax over chunks, the exact merge of two partial attention results by their log-sum-exps, a tiled forward pass, the classification of causal tiles into skip, full and masked, and a count of HBM reads and writes against the standard implementation. The capstone is a tiled causal forward pass with tile skipping that returns the log-sum-exp the backward pass needs.

steps.name: Which causal tiles can be skipped
